about_the_game:
Descend into the unknown. Explore the depths. Become a legend.

Discover a vast and mysterious underwater world hidden beneath a remote cave on the surface.
With procedurally generated cave systems and up to 9,999 unique underwater environments to explore, no two dives are ever the same.

Equip yourself, dive deep, and uncover the secrets of the abyss.

Key Features

  • Procedurally Generated Underwater Caves
    Every cave is unique. Explore thousands of underwater tunnels filled with danger, beauty, and mystery.

  • Crystals & Upgrades
    Collect rare crystals during your dives and sell them to upgrade your gear — increase your oxygen capacity, battery life, flashlight range, and thermal suit resistance.

  • Survival Exploration Mechanics
    Manage your resources carefully. Your oxygen, battery, and heat are limited — and the deeper you go, the colder and more dangerous it becomes.

  • In-Depth Dive Logging
    Each dive is tracked: time, depth, distance traveled, water temperature, and whether you completed the cave or not.

  • Global Leaderboards
    Submit your dive data to global leaderboards and compete with players around the world.
    Include your country flag and see how your exploration skills rank in:

    • Specific cave leaderboards

    • Country-based rankings

    • Top 10 explorers worldwide

    Hall of Fame
    Only the most dedicated players who unlock all achievements will be permanently honored in the Hall of Fame, alongside their name and flag.

A World That Grows With You

Explore, upgrade, survive.
Master the darkness, conquer the cold, and leave your mark in the deepest corners of the world.

name: Cave Dive

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 or AMD Radeon R9 270
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
